AbhiHub Help Center

Everything you need to know about navigating AbhiHub, finding the best study materials, and contributing to the community.

🔍 Finding Resources

How do I find Previous Year Question Papers (PYQs)?

You can find PYQs by using the Global Search Bar on the homepage. Just type the subject name (e.g., "DBMS PYQ" or "Data Structures") and use the filter chips to narrow down by "College" and "Year".

Alternatively, you can browse all papers directly from our dedicated PYQ Landing Page.

Are the study notes and practical files free?

Yes! Absolutely everything on AbhiHub is completely free for students. Our goal is to democratize education by allowing students to share notes, assignments, and practicals freely.

📤 Uploading & Contributing

How can I upload my own notes or exam papers?

Uploading is simple and helps thousands of other students. Just visit the Upload Page, drag and drop your PDFs or Images, select the correct subject and college, and hit submit. Your files will be immediately available in the AbhiHub database.

What is the Store Room?

The Store Room is where you can view your pending uploads and correctly label any files that you bulk-uploaded without metadata. Proper labeling ensures your files appear in search results.

🤖 Features & Tools

How does the AI Chat work on document pages?

When you open an image-based exam paper, you will see an "Ask AI about this paper" panel. We automatically extract the text (OCR) from the question paper. You can then click the one-click persona buttons (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude) to instantly copy an optimized prompt and solve the paper step-by-step!

What is the AbhiHub Leaderboard?

We believe contributors should be recognized. Every time you upload a helpful resource, you gain Reputation Points (XP). You can track your rank globally or within your specific college on the Leaderboard Page.

⚙️ Account & Settings

How do I update my College or Department?

Simply navigate to your Account Settings (or Profile). There, you can select your default college and department. This helps us personalize the resources you see on your dashboard.

Need more help?

If you encounter a bug, have a feature request, or just want to say hi, feel free to visit our Contact Us page. The development team actively reviews all feedback!
